clue.text: Fix advance cover for retirement

parts.note: to bed something in is to fix it firmly in place

explanation.walkthrough: 'Retirement' reads as leaving work, but here it is going to bed for the night.
explanation.definitionFit: A bedspread is the decorative top layer laid over a bed, which you retire to at night.

clue.text: Conceded brother was in debt

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for brother
